messages:
maya: Opened PR: docs update for private/on-prem KMS + networking tips, plus new SDK snippets for client-certs and proxy chaining. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 :rocket:
sam: Nice — can you include a tiny migration checklist for customers moving keys from hosted KMS -> onprem HSM? We've had confusion about key-wrap metadata.
maya: Yup. Added a small Migration note: export key-wrap metadata, import into HSM, then rotate wrapping keys. Included one-line example using our key-export tool.
ashley: Also please call out PKCS#11 listener port (1500) and that some HSM packages expose a unix socket vs TCP. Customers missed this twice.
maya: Added port matrix under Networking section and a "PKCS#11 endpoints" FAQ. Also added /etc/hosts fallback pattern for sealed networks where DNS is restricted.
liam: For networking, we should mention nftables conntrack issue and kube-proxy iptables vs ipvs behavior. Small debug tips would help.
maya: Added bullet on conntrack timeouts and a link to the onprem net-debug script (internal link).
sam: For the SDK snippet, prefer using `kms.internal` as the service hostname (follow our internal naming conventions). Also include both python requests and curl examples.
maya: Switched to kms.internal. Current python snippet: ```python
import requests
resp = requests.post("https://kms.internal/v1/sign", cert=("/etc/ssl/client.crt", "/etc/ssl/client.key"), json={"payload":"..."}, verify="/etc/ssl/ca.pem")
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
And curl: ```bash
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca.pem https://kms.internal/v1/sign -d '{"payload":"..."}'
```
liam: Suggest adding a warning about turning off TLS verification. Don't recommend `verify=false` in docs.
maya: Added explicit warning and an alternate dev-only curl example with `-k` flagged as unsafe.
devops-bot: CI: docs lint OK for PR 1290
ashley: Can we add a short troubleshooting checklist: NodePort mapping, kube-proxy mode, calico SNAT, and HSM firewall rules? Even a one-liner to check PKCS#11 port `ss -ltnp | grep 1500` would help.
maya: Done. Put the checklist at the end of the Networking page under Troubleshooting.
sam: One more: linkcheck may flag external HSM vendor docs. Prefer linking our internal HSM quickstart page.
maya: Replaced the external link with https://docs.redwood.com/onprem/hsm-quickstart and fixed a stale link to the installer checksum page.
devops-bot: CI: docs build + linkcheck found 1 broken link -> https://old.vendor.com/hsm-guide
maya: Replaced that and pushed. Devops-bot: running again.
devops-bot: CI: all checks passed. PR 1290 merged by maya :tada:
